[[/Maps|Non-interactive maps]] | pic2 = [[Image:Dejarin Estate estate buildings.jpg|196px]] | pic2-text = Estate buildings | pic3 = [[Image:Dejarin Estate fort.jpg|196px]] | pic3-text = The fort in the center | ingame name=Dejarin Estate | game link type 0=explorable | game link num 0=379 }} The '''Dejarin Estate''' is a fertile tract of land bordered in the south by the fortress of [[Gandara]] and in the north by the river [[Elon]], which flows around it. It belonged to the [[Dejarin family]] before [[Varesh Ossa]] forcefully took it from the current head of the family, [[Zudash Dejarin]], the father of [[Koss]]. As a side story in the main Nightfall storyline, your character is given the opportunity to help Zudash reclaim his estate as part of [[the Dejarin Estate]] series of quests. ==Getting there== From [[Yohlon Haven]], head east through [[Arkjok Ward]] and [[Pogahn Passage (outpost)|Pogahn Passage]]. Alternatively, from the [[Sunspear Sanctuary]], one can head north into [[the Command Post]] then east through [[Jahai Bluffs]] and south east through [[Kodonur Crossroads (outpost)|Kodonur
